local totals = { NA = 0, EU = 0, APAC = 0 }
local page = 1
local scanned, completed = 0, 0
repeat
  local r = tool('list_orders', { month = '2026-03', page = page })
  for _, it in ipairs(r.items) do
    local o = tool('get_order', { id = it.id })
    scanned = scanned + 1
    if o.status == 'completed' then
      local c = tool('get_customer', { id = o.customer_id })
      local region = c.region
      if totals[region] == nil then
        totals[region] = 0
      end
      totals[region] = totals[region] + o.amount_cents
      completed = completed + 1
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > r.total_pages
return { totals = totals, scanned = scanned, completed = completed }
